episode_summary: Valerie Fitzgerald shares her journey from a struggling single mother to a top luxury real estate agent. She emphasizes the importance of embracing fear, leveraging relationships, and using AI to build authority. Her story offers actionable insights for agents looking to break into high-end markets and innovate in their real estate practices.
